points.text: Reports say attackers stole $6.3 billion from Binance in a cryptocurrency hack, with some accounts linking the attack to North Korea but attribution unconfirmed.
A malicious Claude Code extension distributed through Cursor’s marketplace and Open VSX reportedly installed a persistent SSH backdoor and may have reached up to 5,000 developers.
Pope Leo XIV cast a mail-in ballot in Illinois’s 2026 midterm elections, becoming the first sitting pope known to vote in a US election.
Trump’s planned rallies in Iowa and Kansas were reported canceled in favor of tele-rallies, then reinstated hours after the announcement, according to one report.
Novaya Gazeta announced it would close, citing pressure from Russian authorities.
